LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Grenadier.label: Grenadier
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Grenadier.description:
A Soldat derivative for attacking and defending in trenches and underground tunnel networks, using a composite camera and a specialized operating system to enhance its ballistic calculations when using indirect-fire weapons.

Best equipped with explosives such as hand grenades or grenade launchers to clear fortifications and positions.

The battery pack it carries has a long battery life, but also leaves it unable to fight without cover.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Grenadier.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Grenadier.tools.left_fist.label: left fist
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Kanonier.label: Kanonier
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Kanonier.description: A Soldat conversion using a high-strength alloy skeleton, with higher output to carry heavy weapons such as rocket launchers and recoilless rifles.\n\nThe battery pack it carries has a long battery life, but also leaves it unable to fight without cover.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Kanonier.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Kanonier.tools.left_fist.label: left fist
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Kanonier.tools.right_fist.label: right fist
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Sergeant.label: Sergeant
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Sergeant.description: As a relay command variant of the Soldat, it has a very recognizable disc-shaped omnidirectional radar and transceiver antenna. Sergeants extend a mechanitor's effective range and can be equipped with the same weapons rated for human use as a standard Soldat.
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Sergeant.tools.head.label: head
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Sergeant.tools.left_fist.label: left fist
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Sergeant.tools.right_fist.label: right fist
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Soldat.label: Soldat
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_Soldat.description: An ancient humanoid mech model dating back to the civil wars before humanity's age of colonization, used to advance the line alongside armored groups on open plains and to clear underground fortifications. Thanks to its design philosophy and tactical role, the Soldat is remarkably cheap to produce and maintain, but can only operate relatively simple weapons.\n\nThe battery pack it carries has a long battery life, but also leaves it unable to fight without cover.
